name: Dicero
summary:
Dicero is a fast-paced casual roguelite adventure where strategy and fate collide with every roll of the dice. Players embark on a journey through pixelated battlefields, unleashing powerful skills and crushing enemies in an ever-changing landscape. By combining simple, intuitive controls with deep strategic depth, the game challenges players to build unique heroes from hundreds of skills and gear combinations, ensuring that no two runs are ever the same.

Designed for both quick sessions and deep tactical exploration, Dicero focuses on instant progression and high-impact combat. As heroes grow stronger by the second, players must master infinite skill combos to dominate increasingly difficult challenges. Whether you are looking for easy-to-learn mechanics or a rewarding strategy experience, Dicero offers an addictive journey where your destiny is determined by the luck of the roll and the strength of your build.
